historical_pending_repairs: Preserve pending prepared.frame.Exit as well as error before discarding old-extent packet

resolved_repairs: resizeSource preserves joined Exit/error before any mutation or next Next
Final capture uses renderer.width/height of the last consumed packet and executes before resize adaptation
runtime mode reports stored model/layer/glow construction latches

limits: Hide/Show is visibility pressure, not demonstrated compositor occlusion or minimize/restore
